faq.q: What if the AI gets something wrong?
faq.a: That is why every workflow has a human checkpoint. Nothing customer-facing goes live without someone on your team or ours approving it, and we tune prompts and rules as errors show up.

faq.q: Do we have to change our tools?
faq.a: Usually not. We connect to the shop, CRM, inbox and spreadsheets you already use. If a tool has no API, we tell you up front.
You do. Workflows run in accounts in your name where possible, and every one is documented and handed over.

faq.q: How long does a first automation take?
faq.a: A focused automation is typically live within two to four weeks: one week of discovery, one to two weeks for a prototype on real data, then a short pilot.

faq.q: Which processes are a bad fit for AI?
faq.a: Tasks that happen rarely, need judgement on every single case, or where one mistake is very expensive. We’ll say so in the opportunity check rather than build something you don’t need.
